_readme: Public file: categories and generic merchant patterns only. Never put amounts, names of people or account details here. Rules you create in the app ('Apply to all from this merchant') are stored inside the encrypted vault and win over these. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions tested against the statement description. First match wins.

planTemplate._readme: Default split of the monthly spending budget (shares of the spend amount). Investing/savings comes first and isn't a line here: it's the plan's save %. Every line can be edited in the app.

products._readme: Words in a product title (Amazon order history, receipts) and the category they belong to. Matched word by word; '*' matches the start of a word. The category with the most matches wins.

productDepartments._readme: Store department names (Amazon's Category column and similar) and the category they belong to. Matched as whole words in the department name.
